★Request
Fade in

Listen to this tremendous roar from the crowd! All eyes are undoubtedly
on these two titans representing the pinnacle of modern Umamusume racing!!

And Daiwa Scarlet smoothly glides to the front right from the start!
What fantastic positioning! She's firmly taken command of the pace!
I wanted to... show you so badly...!
So, do you know why I never doubted it?

Even as I grew up, even when we were separated—
because you were always, always right there in my heart.

Hmph, the only thing I'm prepared to do is make you cry!
Oh... hello everyone! Please cheer for me today!

As I speak, I step directly in front of her—one step closer than usual.
And looking straight into her eyes, I speak to her softly.

And with that, it really sinks in.
It seems... she has pulled ahead of me once again.

That I would definitely reach that dream spectacular view.
I've never doubted that, not even once.
Focus...?

That I could run in a way that enchants everyone, that makes everyone want to cheer.
Do you know why I was always able to believe that?

(It's okay, don't rush. Save up your legs, and if you turn it into a late stretch battle—
"even against Daiwa Scarlet, you can fight"!)
...So, what about it?

She was already crazy good, but... did she just level up even more?
Is it, like, totally thanks to that person we know about or what?!
...Yes.

! ...—Fufu, yeah, that's true.
I guess I got completely caught up in the crowd's excitement.

...I simply nod in silence. My thinking was naive, plain and simple.
Filled with frustration and regret, just as I was about to apologize—

(It hurts, so much...! But I won't give it up! I want to win, I will win!!
This... if nothing else, I have to win this—!)
Hyaaaaaaaah...!!

But I'm okay now! Thank you, I'm off.
—I'm going to bring home a win, Trainer!

Once more. As many times as it takes.
So that I can catch up to her running ahead, and support her from behind.

200 meters remaining! Will it be Vodka, Daiwa Scarlet, or Buena Vista?!
Buena Vista is closing in fast! The finish post is right before their eyes—!

(It's okay, don't rush. Save up your legs, and if you turn it into a late stretch battle—
"even against Daiwa Scarlet, you can fight"!)
Oh, wait. Was I—
Wait.

Because you were always, always captivated by my running.
Because you were always, always cheering for me with all your heart!

However! Still proudly staking her claim with a fierce
"I won't give up victory," is this up-and-coming Umamusume—!

Whoooo! Buena Vistaaa!!
Do your beeeeeeeeeest!!

Incredible! It's hard to believe this level of anticipation and attention
is centered around pre-debut Umamusume! What kind of race will we witness today?!

...Ugh, it hurts.
It's so frustrating, seriously...!!

Even so, my story will not stop.
Fufufufu...♪

She had long since fixed her sights on the answer we needed to reach.
Embarrassed once more that I was the older one, I... finally open my mouth.

Every time she flashes a smile from the paddock, the crowd erupts in excitement.
After watching that sight intently—

...I just realized.
I was really tense, wasn't I?

(Vodka-chan's explosive late stretch power is... terrifying!
But at the same time, it can waver... That's why!!)

I'm so frustrated, so frustrated! I wanted to show you!
That as long as you're here—that because I'm with you, I can win!

Umamusume have incredibly sharp hearing, after all. So sharp that even down here
in the underground passage, the cheers echoing from outside are crystal clear.

They might not be quite as polished as they'd be for the real Twinkle Series,
but I'm sure they'll put on a magnificent race for us!

Even so, her exceptional hearing still has clear directional focus.
That is why I call out to her slowly and clearly.

I had to! Today... If there was ever a day, today was the day I had to win.
I wanted... I wanted to prove it to you so badly.

Now then, stepping up next are the two you've all been waiting for!
Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet!!
—Yes, absolutely. My Trainer!

If we're starting over, I'd like to do it from the very beginning.
...Would that be okay?

...I told you before, didn't I?
Back when you asked me about the "spectacular view" I wanted to aim for.

Just then, tap.
...She gently extends her index finger, lightly brushing against my lips.
I'm sorry. May I ask for just one selfish favor?
All right, let's do this! Rrrraaaagh!!

Sheesh. Closing in to finish third by a nose against that pack of monsters...
Unbelievable as always. ...Way to keep things interesting.

I see. Buena-san... Hehe, is that so?
I just felt a divine guidance.

I'm Buena Vista. I trained with everything I had for today!
It's nice to meet you!

Phew...
—It's all over, isn't it?
(WAAAAAAHHH...!!)

She continued to shed quiet tears for a while.
Almost... as if she had returned to those childhood days. And then—
And at last... the fateful individual event competition got underway.

Daiwa Scarlet takes the lead! Vodka is right behind her!!
And yet, and yet, here comes Buena Vista! Buena Vista is making her move too!
Hah, hah... Hmph—!!

Heh, let's do this!
Hey, Scarlet, you ready to lose to me?
And so, once again. We face each other at our promised place.

Ah, there you are...!
You said you wanted to talk before heading out to the track... What's up?
—It's because you've always been there for me!
